chairOptions.label: In person / face-to-face
chairOptions.description: Meets on campus at scheduled days/times.

chairOptions.label: Fully online (asynchronous)
chairOptions.description: Fully Online Instruction. Students are required to log in to Canvas by the first day of class for detailed information and required course work. https://canvas.sac.edu There will be no instructional meetings.

chairOptions.label: Fully online live (Zoom)
chairOptions.description: Fully Online Live Instruction.  Live streaming instruction via Zoom during the days and times indicated. Students log in to Canvas. https://canvas.sac.edu.  There will be no instruction on-campus.

chairOptions.label: On-campus hybrid
chairOptions.description: On-Campus Hybrid Instruction. A combination of on-campus meetings during the days and times indicated and online instruction. Students log in to Canvas. https://canvas.sac.edu

chairOptions.label: Virtual hybrid
chairOptions.description: Virtual Hybrid Instruction. A combination of some live streaming instruction via Zoom during the days and times indicated and online instruction. Students log in to Canvas. https://canvas.sac.edu.  There will be no instruction on-campus.

chairOptions.label: Campus + live streaming hybrid
chairOptions.description: On-Campus Hybrid and Virtual Instruction. A combination of on-campus and live streaming meetings during the days and times indicated . Students log in to Canvas. https://canvas.sac.edu

chairOptions.label: Arranged / TBA / work experience
chairOptions.description: Hours arranged or work experience; scheduler review required.
